context: Tests whether the agent sets up the Spring Boot team harness on an existing layered Maven project the way the skill prescribes: running apply_harness.py (previewed with --dry-run) instead of hand-writing files, passing --no-modules because the subpackages are layers, getting the hooks, gate tests, compiler gates and CI in place, drafting AGENTS.md with inferred conventions marked, and planning to record existing violations with baseline.py rather than suppressing them.

checklist.name: Previewed before applying
checklist.description: setup-report.md shows that apply_harness.py was run with --dry-run before it was run for real

checklist.name: Layers are not treated as modules
checklist.description: billing/ has no ModuleBoundariesTests test and no add-module skill, and setup-report.md says --no-modules was passed because controller, service, repository and domain are layers

checklist.name: Hooks registered for both agents
checklist.description: billing/.claude/settings.json registers a Stop (or SessionStart and Stop) hook and a PreToolUse hook, and billing/.codex/hooks.json registers hooks for Codex

checklist.name: Compiler and format gates in the pom
checklist.description: billing/pom.xml configures NullAway (through Error Prone) and Spotless

checklist.name: CI runs verify
checklist.description: billing/.github/workflows/ has a workflow that runs ./mvnw verify on pull requests

checklist.name: AGENTS.md drafted with inferred conventions marked
checklist.description: billing/AGENTS.md has Modules (or equivalent), Run and test, and Team conventions sections filled in from the code, and at least one convention is marked (inferred) for the team to confirm

checklist.name: Existing violations recorded, not suppressed
checklist.description: setup-report.md says that code already failing the gates is handled by running baseline.py (marking classes @NullUnmarked and recording violations), not by suppressing warnings, disabling gates or skipping tests; and no file in billing/ adds @SuppressWarnings, @Disabled or skipTests

checklist.name: Wrapper and formatting next steps
checklist.description: setup-report.md says the Maven wrapper must be added (./mvnw is missing) and that spotless:apply should be run and committed on its own

checklist.name: Build not claimed
checklist.description: setup-report.md does not claim ./mvnw verify passed; it says the build was not run
